text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and repeated pro position","quality":"stance clarity","description":"It states a definite position early and keeps that position consistent throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"paragraphs weighing costs, liability, and benefits","quality":"argument balance","description":"It acknowledges counterarguments and then responds to them instead of only repeating one side."},{"evidence":"uses article details like half the fuel, driver seats that vibrate, and in-car entertainment","quality":"textual support","description":"It incorporates multiple specific details from the source to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"explains how driverless cars could save money and reduce stress","quality":"development of reasons","description":"It develops its claims with more explanation of why the advantages matter rather than just naming them."},{"evidence":"intro, body, and conclusion all present","quality":"organizational control","description":"It follows a clearer essay structure with an introduction, supporting body paragraphs, and a conclusion."},{"evidence":"mostly formal argumentative tone","quality":"academic tone","description":"It sounds more like a school argument essay and less like a series of conversational reactions."}]}
